mapper.insert: insert into tb_take_orders (order_id, user_id, create_time, deleted, status, delivery_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{deleted}, #{status}, #{deliveryTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{cancelReason})
mapper.select: select * from tb_take_orders where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select * from tb_take_orders where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 for update
mapper.sql:
SELECT take_order.id, take_order.taker_id, take_order.take_status, take_order.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, users.realname, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, take_order.take_order_create_time, take_order.take_order_delivery_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders AS orders,
tb_user AS users,
tb_category AS category,
(SELECT take_order.id, take_order.user_id AS taker_id, take_order.status AS take_status, take_order.order_id, take_order.create_time AS take_order_create_time, take_order.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, take_order.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, take_order.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_take_orders AS take_order WHERE take_order.user_id = #{id} AND take_order.deleted = 0 ) AS take_order,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id AND orders.id = take_order.order_id AND orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.deleted = 0 AND orders.category_id = category.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY take_order.take_order_create_time desc, take_order.id desc LIMIT 20

SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, orders.order_number, orders.price, orders.product_amount, orders.business_type, (orders.product_amount + orders.price) AS runner_receivable, orders.expected_delivery_time, orders.delivery_time, orders.cancel_time, orders.cancel_reson, orders.exceed_time, orders.gap, orders.create_time, orders.door_access, orders.user_id, orders.username, orders.phone, users.realname, orders.status, orders.note, orders.category_id, category.category_name, take_order.take_order_create_time, take_order.take_order_delivery_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_time, take_order.take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders AS orders,
tb_user AS users,
tb_category AS category,
(SELECT take_order.id, take_order.order_id, take_order.create_time AS take_order_create_time, take_order.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, take_order.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, take_order.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_take_orders AS take_order
and id = #{id} and order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId}
and deleted = #{deleted} and status = #{status}
) AS take_order,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' ) AS address_recive
WHERE orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND orders.id = address_recive.id AND orders.id = take_order.order_id AND orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.category_id = category.id ORDER BY take_order.take_order_create_time desc, take_order.id desc LIMIT 20

mapper.sql:
SELECT tk.id, tk.taker_id, tk.take_status, tk.order_id, address_pick_up.address AS pick_up_address, address_recive.address AS recive_address, tb_orders.`order_number`, tb_orders.`price`, tb_orders.`product_amount`, tb_orders.`business_type`, (tb_orders.`product_amount` + tb_orders.`price`) AS runner_receivable, tb_orders.expected_delivery_time, tb_orders.`delivery_time`, tb_orders.`cancel_time`, tb_orders.`cancel_reson`, tb_orders.`exceed_time`, tb_orders.`gap`, tb_orders.`create_time`, tb_orders.`door_access`, tb_orders.`user_id`, tb_orders.`username`, tb_orders.`phone`, tb_user.`realname`, tb_orders.`status`, tb_orders.`note`, tb_orders.`category_id`, tb_category.`category_name` AS category_name, tk.create_time AS take_order_create_time, tk.delivery_time AS take_order_delivery_time, tk.cancel_time AS take_order_cancel_time, tk.cancel_reason AS take_order_cancel_reason
FROM tb_orders, tb_user, tb_category, ( SELECT id, user_id AS taker_id, status AS take_status, create_time, delivery_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, order_id FROM tb_take_orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND STATUS = 2 ) AS tk,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'PICKUP' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_pick_up,
(SELECT order_id AS id, address FROM tb_order_address_snapshot WHERE role = 'RECEIVE' AND school_id = #{schoolId} ) AS address_recive
WHERE tb_orders.deleted = 0 AND tb_orders.id = tk.order_id AND tb_orders.status = #{orderStatus} AND tb_orders.id = address_pick_up.id AND tb_orders.id = address_recive.id AND tb_user.id = tb_orders.`user_id` AND tb_orders.`category_id` = tb_category.id AND tb_orders.`price` IS NOT NULL AND tb_orders.`price` != 0
mapper.select: ORDER BY tk.create_time desc, tk.id desc LIMIT 20
ORDER BY tk.create_time desc, tk.id desc LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

sql.if: AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{keyword}), LOWER(COALESCE(o.order_number, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{keyword}), LOWER(COALESCE(pub_user.realname, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{keyword}), LOWER(COALESCE(tk_user.realname, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, COALESCE(tk_user.phone, '')) > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_user pub_user ON o.user_id = pub_user.id WHERE tk.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (5, 7)

SELECT tk.id, tk.order_id, o.order_number, o.status AS order_status, tk.status AS take_order_status, c.category_name, o.price, o.product_amount, o.business_type, (o.product_amount + o.price) AS runner_receivable, o.service_fee, o.pay_amount, o.note AS order_note, ap.address AS pick_up_address, ar.address AS recive_address, pub_user.realname AS publisher_name, o.phone AS publisher_phone, tk_user.realname AS taker_name, tk_user.phone AS taker_phone, tk.create_time AS take_order_time, tk.delivery_time FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON o.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_user pub_user ON o.user_id = pub_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ap ON o.id = ap.order_id AND ap.role = 'PICKUP' LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ar ON o.id = ar.order_id AND ar.role = 'RECEIVE' WHERE tk.deleted = 0
ORDER BY tk.create_time DESC, tk.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT tk.id, tk.order_id, o.order_number, o.status AS order_status, tk.status AS take_order_status, c.category_name, o.price, o.product_amount, o.business_type, (o.product_amount + o.price) AS runner_receivable, o.service_fee, o.pay_amount, o.note AS order_note, ap.address AS pick_up_address, ar.address AS recive_address, pub_user.realname AS publisher_name, o.phone AS publisher_phone, tk_user.realname AS taker_name, tk_user.phone AS taker_phone, tk.create_time AS take_order_time, tk.delivery_time FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON o.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tb_user tk_user ON tk.user_id = tk_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_user pub_user ON o.user_id = pub_user.id LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ap ON o.id = ap.order_id AND ap.role = 'PICKUP' LEFT JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot ar ON o.id = ar.order_id AND ar.role = 'RECEIVE' WHERE tk.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (5, 7)
ORDER BY tk.create_time DESC, tk.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.product_amount + o.price), 0) FROM tb_take_orders tk INNER JOIN tb_orders o ON tk.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (5, 7) WHERE tk.deleted = 0
